qa_pair.question: Ping the Unity bridge and report only the bridge version string in X.Y.Z format.
What is the name of the currently active scene? Return just the scene name without path or extension.
List the first page of the scene hierarchy with defaults. How many root objects are there in total? Return just the number.
Find all GameObjects whose name contains 'Enemy' (case-insensitive). How many are there? Return just the number.
What is the full hierarchy path of the GameObject tagged 'Player'? Return just the path.
Which component type on 'Level/Player' controls its physics body? Return just the component type name.
What is the current play-mode state of the Editor? Respond with exactly one of: stopped, playing, paused.
Read the console filtered to errors only. What is the first word of the most recent error message? Return just that word.
Among root objects, which one has the most children? Return just its name.
Is the active scene currently dirty (unsaved changes)? Respond True or False.
